## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 112 captures during May 2024. This activity provides the basis for the site’s review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The total of 112 captures is reported for Oakridge Primary Care and relates specifically to May 2024.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during May 2024, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 4.5. This result is recorded alongside the total activity of 112 captures and provides the measure used for the site’s image quality assessment. The ungradable count and the ungradable_rate are presented together to support review of the month’s performance at Oakridge Primary Care.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results from the activity recorded in May 2024. The median lag was 2. This is the reported midpoint for the interval associated with grading during the month. Taken together, the grading information records 14 referable results and a median lag of 2 for Oakridge Primary Care. These findings should be considered with the 112 captures and the image quality results, including 5 ungradable captures and an ungradable_rate of 4.5.
